connectBunq.consent: Connecting gives TeamBalance bunq’s standard app access to this bunq login, which is more than reading: bunq’s default grant also allows creating payments and draft payments. TeamBalance only reads the balance and payments of the one account you pick and stores no payment data, only the receipts members add to expenses. Every member of this team will see the balance and the names, dates and amounts of payments on that account. You can disconnect in TeamBalance at any time, which deletes the access it stored; to withdraw the grant at bunq itself, remove TeamBalance under connected apps in the bunq app.
